intro: This quest involves recovering the comprehensive personal memoirs of Archmage Antonidas, the revered late leader of the Kirin Tor. Originally housed within the grand archives of Ironforge, the rare tome provides irreplaceable insight into the history of Dalaran and high arcane scholarship.
